subtitle.zh: 来源：ckb-system-scripts / c/dao.c　·　DAO = type script（code_hash 0x82d7…3f2e，hash_type type）
subtitle.en: Source: ckb-system-scripts / c/dao.c　·　DAO = type script (code_hash 0x82d7…3f2e, hash_type type)

cond.zh: 输出必须与 deposit 输入在同一 index i
cond.en: the output must be at the same index i as the deposit input
same DAO script as the input

cond.zh: 8 字节 u64 LE，等于 D 的区块号
cond.en: 8-byte u64 LE equal to block number of D

cond.zh: 必须包含区块 D 的 hash
cond.en: must include the hash of block D

note.zh: CKB 节点可能要求 lock 大小相同，未核实
note.en: the CKB node may require the same lock size; unverified

cond.zh: 8 字节，值为 D 在 header_deps 中的下标 k
cond.en: 8 bytes; value is k, the index of D in header_deps

cond.zh: 包含 D 和 W；D 的区块号必须等于 data，且 W 的 epoch 必须晚于 D
cond.en: contains D and W; D's block number must equal data, and W's epoch must be later than D's

cond.zh: 绝对 epoch，且 ≥ D.epoch + ⌈存款 epoch 数 / 180⌉ × 180
≤ 普通输入 + Σ 最大可提取

note.zh: AR 取自区块头 dao 字段
note.en: AR is read from the header's dao field
